as_told.title: Dulles brothers funded the rise of the Nazis

plain: American money, the story goes, helped bring the Nazis to power in Germany in the 1920s and 1930s. Michels tells it himself, without a source, saying a bank called the Union Bank funded the Nazis and that a man named Allen Dulles helped finance them too, while stationed, he thinks, "in Norway or something." A researcher named Jason Jorjani says that Allen Dulles and his brother John Foster Dulles, together with the bank JP Morgan Chase, the Rockefeller family and a man named Prescott Bush, "funded the rise of the Nazis," and does not mention the Union Bank. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells a broader version without those names: that American industrialists wanted Hitler to set up a fascist government. If true, it would mean powerful Americans helped build the regime their country later fought.
